basis_normalization: Within each aryl/ring scan, the +000 feature vector is subtracted from every row; each training baseline is identically zero.
consequence: The original design cannot identify all eight independent Fourier coefficients, regardless of improved numerical runtime. The original held-out split and limits must be retained; no missing or failed observation may be removed.
scope: This is an energy-independent counting argument about individual coefficient identification, not rejection of a native force-field energy solely due to this count. Original native profile and method-sensitivity gates remain separate.
possible_followup: Any new identifiable coefficient study requires a separately frozen design with additional independent, chemically meaningful geometries selected without using held-out energies; current aggregate fit cannot be promoted to independent family parameters.
